This is the public part of my work, most of it from my years at CIAT. My industry work for Globant's clients isn't public, so it appears only as a summary on the [CV](cv.qmd). Tutorial repositories in R and Python will land here as I publish them.

::: {.project .project-lead}
### Forecasting the El Niño signal

[State-space model · Kalman filter · Python]{.project-meta}

{{< include _fan-chart.md >}}

<p class="fan-caption">The Oceanic Niño Index through September 2026, the El Niño signal behind much of the year-to-year swing in Colombia's rainfall, with a 24-month forecast and its 50% and 90% intervals. A state-space model fitted with a Kalman filter, <a href="https://github.com/Jeikosd/jeikosd.github.io/blob/main/scripts/fan_chart.py">in about 200 lines of Python</a>.</p>
:::

::: {.project}
### AClimate Colombia

[Seasonal forecasting · CIAT · 2020]{.project-meta}

A system that delivers seasonal climate forecasts and agro-climatic information to support climate risk decisions in Colombia. I worked on the statistical models behind it as part of the team at CIAT.

[Paper in *Computers and Electronics in Agriculture*](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.compag.2020.105486)
:::

::: {.project}
### Seasonal forecasts for rainfed maize

[Forecasting · R · CIAT · 2022]{.project-meta}

Applying agro-climatic seasonal forecasts to rainfed maize management in Colombia. My R code for USAID maize forecasting at CIAT is public, with 126 commits.

[Paper in *Climate Services*](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cliser.2022.100333) · [Code on GitHub](https://github.com/CIAT-DAPA/usaid_forecast_maize)
:::

::: {.project}
### Agro-climatic hotspots (AgMetGaps)

[Machine learning · R · USAID · 2017–2018]{.project-meta}

Where in the world could climate services help close crop yield gaps? I worked on the data processing and on the statistical and machine learning models.

[Project site](https://ciat-dapa.github.io/AgMetGaps/) · [Code on GitHub](https://github.com/CIAT-DAPA/AgMetGaps)
:::

::: {.project}
### Climate change and crops in Latin America and the Caribbean

[Crop simulation · DSSAT and ORYZA · IDB and USAID · 2016]{.project-meta}

Simulations of near-term climate change impacts on major crops, built on crop models and statistical analysis.

[AGU abstract](https://agu.confex.com/agu/fm16/meetingapp.cgi/Paper/184950)
:::

::: {.project}
### Climate vulnerability of *Espeletia* in the páramo

[Climate modelling · 2020 · my most cited paper]{.project-meta}

An assessment of how climate change threatens the *Espeletia* complex on the páramo sky islands of the northern Andes. Co-author.

[Paper in *Frontiers in Ecology and Evolution*](https://doi.org/10.3389/fevo.2020.565708)
:::

::: {.project}
### The spectrum of cumbia

[Time series · R · thesis co-direction · 2023]{.project-meta}

An undergraduate thesis in statistics at Universidad del Valle that I co-directed. It extracts fundamental-frequency time series from 30 cumbia songs in R and summarises them with principal component analysis. In Spanish.

[Open access thesis](https://hdl.handle.net/10893/30344)
:::
